Questions and answers

What is Schubumkehr?

In this glossary, Schubumkehr refers to: A device used to redirect engine thrust forward to assist with deceleration after landing.

How is Schubumkehr used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Nach dem Aufsetzen sofort Schubumkehr einsetzen, um den Bremsweg auf nasser Bahn zu verkürzen."
